title: Invisalign vs Braces: Free Orthodontic Consultations
description: Clear aligners vs traditional braces for teens and adults: how they work, insurance coverage for orthodontics, HSA use and what a free consultation covers.
intro: Straighter teeth are within reach at any age. Compare clear aligners and braces, check your orthodontic coverage and book a free first visit.

image.alt: Person fitting a clear plastic aligner over their teeth

Aligners prescribed and monitored in person by an orthodontist or dentist allow X-rays, regular check-ins and adjustments. Mail-order aligner models with less in-person supervision have been around for years, but the American Association of Orthodontists recommends an in-person exam before starting treatment. See our detailed comparison.

Many dental plans include orthodontic coverage for children under a set age, often with a separate lifetime maximum; adult orthodontic coverage is less common. Medicaid and CHIP may cover medically necessary orthodontics for children. HSA and FSA funds can usually be used for braces and aligners.

faqs.a: Many do. The first visit often includes an exam and treatment options; ask whether X-rays or scans are included.

faqs.q: Am I too old for braces?
faqs.a: No. Adults can have orthodontic treatment as long as their teeth and gums are healthy.
